issue.title: tests: most packages don't stop a test from reaching the network
issue.body:
The code standards say a test never reaches the network. Only 4 of the 65 packages enforce that; the rest rely on each test remembering to.

Found while triaging #2644. `internal/agent` and `internal/usage`, among others, have nothing stopping a test from reaching models.dev or a vendor. So a test can quietly depend on the network or on the machine's cached catalog, and then pass or fail differently from one machine to the next.

Proposed fix: in each package's TestMain (through testenv), set a default transport that refuses any address that isn't loopback. Then add a guard test that fails when a package with tests doesn't install it.

comments.body:
The cause: `testenv.Offline` existed, but `testenv.RunIn` never installed it, so each package had to remember the call in its own `TestMain`. Only `internal/cli`, `internal/gateway`, `internal/plugin` and `internal/provider` did, and 18 packages with tests had no `TestMain` at all.

This branch:

- `testenv.RunIn` installs `Offline` before `m.Run`, so `Run`, `Main` and `RunIn` all give a package the guard; `internal/cli` and `internal/plugin` now use `testenv.Main`, `internal/provider` drops its own call, and `internal/gateway`, which isolates itself without `Run`, keeps its explicit `testenv.Offline`.
- adds `func TestMain(m *testing.M) { testenv.Main(m) }` to those 18 packages.
- adds `TestEveryPackageStaysOffTheNetwork` in `internal/testenv`: a package with `_test.go` files must install `Offline` from its `TestMain`, directly or through `testenv.Run`/`Main`/`RunIn`.

Run: before the change the guard named 18 packages with "the package's tests have no TestMain" and `internal/testenv` with "TestMain doesn't install testenv.Offline, so its tests reach the network"; it passes now. `gofmt -l` on the changed files, `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `GOOS=windows go vet ./...` print nothing. With `Offline()` taken out of `RunIn`, `internal/cli`'s `TestStaysOffTheNetwork` failed with "models.dev answered 200 OK: the package's tests reach the network", so the guard is installed there and not only by a package's own call.

The suites of `internal/testenv`, `internal/cli`, `internal/plugin`, `internal/provider` and the 18 packages pass apart from failures I reproduced on a clean `upstream/main` extract: `TestProgram` and `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink` under this machine's umask 0027, `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, `TestCodexAppServersOnHome`, and a `synctest` fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`. I did not finish a `go test ./...` run: it was killed after 4 minutes with the gateway suite still running behind two other sessions' full suites on the same machine.

[fix/2661-tests-most-packages-don-t](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/2661-tests-most-packages-don-t), commit 6865746c3d8ea816decc601bb439c256f4b21245

This is a fork branch, ready to review; it makes no claim on the issue's ownership.
